text: According to the Reck/Clements decomposition, how many Mach-Zehnder interferometers are needed to implement an arbitrary N×N unitary matrix on optical fields?
explanation: The Reck/Clements theorem decomposes any N×N unitary into N(N−1)/2 MZIs, matching the number of independent 2×2 rotations. N² would count all matrix entries rather than the independent rotations, while 2N and N log N understate the required hardware.
